comparison.common_domain: SW node plus the E/N arm runs through their adjacent-node far edges; node/arms union, no piles or other intersections
comparison.late_transition_domain: SW node plus E/N arms through coordinate 4450; excludes piles and other intersections
comparison.whole_ring_scope: Separate larger counterfactual: 600-wide closed rectangular cold ring and SW local node only, all original 450 mm deep. Excludes internal branches, other enlarged nodes, ground, soil and all pile volumes; not a complete takeoff.

decision: Prefer constant-depth local three-node challenger for further joined design; it removes the vertical bar/soffit taper within the next nodes. This is not a foundation selection, capacity pass or decision to deepen the full perimeter. Transition beyond this group and all interfaces remain open.

envelope_plan_interface.scope: Plan overlap only. Independent weather-leaf bearing, cavity drainage, thermal breaks, DPC/contact, field interface and structural restraint are not proved. MAT 850 mm loggia-sidewall hypothesis is not this ordinary wall.

holds: Actual next-node pile support, size, reinforcement and hold-down forces are unselected; local H25 cages are hypothetical clones

Window heads, wall bearing, non-overlapping floor/wall loads and whole-house signed load patterns unresolved

hypothetical_next_pile_hoops.scope: Two finite closed circles per hypothetical next pile, including one below the node soffit. Closure, pitch, full cage, stress-spread, sequencing and actual pile existence remain unqualified.

down.route: Roof partial action → four SW trial ties → warm/cold station → two arm end couples plus SW group → three ideal pile-axis groups; equal pile-bar forces are a statics witness only.
down.scope: Partial-roof force and first moment only; no predicted stiffness, contact, compression in heads, arm resistance, anchorage, actual pile or whole-house load.

uplift.route: Roof partial action → four SW trial ties → warm/cold station → two arm end couples plus SW group → three ideal pile-axis groups; equal pile-bar forces are a statics witness only.
uplift.scope: Partial-roof force and first moment only; no predicted stiffness, contact, compression in heads, arm resistance, anchorage, actual pile or whole-house load.

repair.scope: Actual continuous point paths include candidate plan and vertical curves to the next-node footprint at 5700; further continuation is unmodelled. Next pile cage is a hypothetical SW-pattern clone, not source-authored reinforcement.

roof_scope.scope: Tip support is a challenger, not a solved selected roof. All other remaining roof faces are unmodelled. No partial load is added to the original collapsed-corner action.

roof_tip_challenger.root_node: One shared, welded SHS80 cross-node above the existing diagonal SHS120 hip end; not two overlapping SHS volumes.
roof_tip_challenger.scope: The tip cantilevers and their shared node are explicit geometry/stress-path challengers. The purlin rectangle bounds the rotated member body in plan, not its deck-bearing face; it is a short stub, and actual roof-deck support to the diagonal edge, full 3D seat/purlin/hip and adjacent-strip clashes, signed weld/anchorage, restraint, weather, ventilation, tolerance, product and capacity remain unproved. Faces beyond these tips remain unmodelled. Extra steel weight remains within/subject to the source G budget, not added again.
